_note: Source of truth for the menu. PRICES ARE ESTIMATES until the owner confirms them. Fields: travels = holds up well for delivery; img = reuse another dish's photo; ru = Russian name. After editing run: python3 build.py

dishes.name: King Fish Rava Fry
dishes.short: Kingfish in a crisp semolina crust with lime, onion salad and green chutney.
dishes.long: A Goan classic and the King Fish from our chalkboard. Thick kingfish steaks marinated in red masala, pressed into semolina and shallow fried until the crust shatters. Served with lime, a crunchy onion salad and green chutney.
dishes.pairing: Chilled beer or fresh lime soda

dishes.name: King Fish Fillet
dishes.short: Pan-seared fillet with garlic butter, lemon and seasonal greens.
dishes.long: A thick fillet of kingfish seared skin-side down for a golden edge, finished with garlic butter and a squeeze of lemon. Served over sauteed greens, it lets the fish do the talking. Light, clean and quietly indulgent.

dishes.name: Goan Fish Curry Rice
dishes.short: Tangy coconut fish curry over steamed rice, the way Goan homes make it.
dishes.long: Fresh catch simmered in a tangy, brick-red coconut gravy sharpened with kokum and Goan chillies. Served with a mound of steamed rice, it is everyday Goan comfort food, honest and deeply flavoured.

dishes.name: Grilled Fish with Lime
dishes.short: Marinated fish grilled over high heat with charred lime and herbs.
dishes.long: Fish marinated in a bright blend of lime, garlic and chilli, then grilled hard until the edges caramelise. A charred lime on the side adds smoky acidity. Simple technique, big flavour.
dishes.pairing: Chilled beer or fresh lime soda

dishes.name: Seafood Pasta
dishes.short: Spaghetti tossed with prawns, mussels and fish in a garlic tomato sauce.
dishes.long: Al dente spaghetti folded through a garlicky tomato and white wine sauce, loaded with the day's seafood. Finished with parsley and a drizzle of olive oil. A European favourite, cooked with a Goan catch.
dishes.pairing: Crisp white wine or lime soda

dishes.name: Fire-Grilled Steak
dishes.short: Open-flame steak, seared hard and rested, with house pepper sauce.
dishes.long: Our namesake. A tender cut grilled over open flame for a smoky crust and a juicy centre, rested, sliced and served with fries and our house pepper sauce. Tell us how you like it cooked and we will match it.
dishes.pairing: Cold beer or a bold red

dishes.name: Pepper Steak Platter
dishes.short: Sizzling sliced steak with asparagus, carrots and peppercorn jus.
dishes.long: Sliced steak arrives on a hot skillet with charred asparagus, glazed carrots and a peppercorn jus, still sizzling at the table. Generous enough to share, elegant enough not to.

dishes.name: Spinach Momos
dishes.short: Large steamed spinach dumplings with a fiery red dip.
dishes.long: Guests keep praising these. Emerald dumplings, generous in size, filled with spinach and soft cheese and steamed until silky. Served with a punchy red chilli dip that wakes everything up.

dishes.name: Crispy Dumplings
dishes.short: Pan-fried dumplings with a golden base and chilli-soy dip.
dishes.long: Pleated dumplings pan-fried until the base turns golden and crisp while the top stays tender. Served with a tangy chilli-soy dip. Best eaten hot, shared fast.

dishes.name: Red Thai Curry
dishes.short: Coconut red curry with fragrant basil and jasmine rice.
dishes.long: A silky coconut curry built on red chilli paste, lemongrass and kaffir lime, finished with fresh basil. Served with steamed jasmine rice to soak up every drop. Warming, aromatic and properly spicy.

dishes.name: Veg Thai Curry
dishes.short: Seasonal vegetables in a fragrant Thai coconut broth.
dishes.long: Crisp seasonal vegetables simmered in a fragrant coconut broth with lemongrass, ginger and lime leaf, topped with fresh herbs. A light, bright vegetarian main served with jasmine rice.

dishes.name: Fresh Lime Soda
dishes.short: Hand-squeezed lime over soda. Sweet, salted or both.
dishes.long: The beach classic. Fresh limes squeezed to order over chilled soda, served sweet, salted or mixed. Cuts through spice and cools a hot Goan afternoon.

dishes.name: Full Breakfast Platter
dishes.short: Eggs your way, sausages, beans, mushrooms, tomato and toast.
dishes.long: The way to start a beach day. Eggs cooked how you like them, sausages, baked beans, sauteed mushrooms, grilled tomato and buttered toast, with tea or coffee on the side if you ask.

dishes.name: Banana Pancakes
dishes.short: Fluffy stack with banana, berries and honey.
dishes.long: A tall stack of soft pancakes layered with sliced banana and berries, finished with a pour of honey. A Goan beach-shack favourite for slow mornings.

dishes.name: Cheese Omelette Skillet
dishes.short: Fluffy eggs with cheese, peppers and herbs, served with toast.
dishes.long: Eggs whisked light and cooked in a skillet with melted cheese, peppers, onion and fresh herbs. Served with buttered toast.

dishes.name: French Toast & Berries
dishes.short: Golden brioche-style toast with banana, blueberries and syrup.
dishes.long: Thick slices soaked in vanilla custard, pan-fried golden, then piled with banana, blueberries and a dusting of sugar.

dishes.name: Couple's Feast
dishes.short: Pepper Steak Platter, Spinach Momos, Chocolate Brownie, 2 Lime Sodas. Free delivery.
dishes.long: Dinner for two, sorted. Our sizzling Pepper Steak Platter to share, a plate of the spinach momos guests keep praising, a Chocolate Brownie to finish and two fresh lime sodas. Worth ₹1,160 a la carte, yours for ₹999, and it ships free.

dishes.name: Family Seafood Feast
dishes.short: 2 King Fish Rava Fry, Seafood Pasta, Crispy Dumplings, 2 Lime Sodas.
dishes.long: A full spread for the family or the villa. Two King Fish Rava Fry, a Seafood Pasta, Crispy Dumplings to share and two fresh lime sodas. Free delivery included. Worth ₹1,840 a la carte.
dishes.pairing: Add Chocolate Brownies for the table

dishes.name: Veggie Feast for Two
dishes.short: Veg Thai Curry, Spinach Momos, Banana Pancakes, 2 Lime Sodas.
dishes.long: A generous vegetarian meal for two: fragrant Veg Thai Curry with jasmine rice, Spinach Momos, Banana Pancakes for dessert and two fresh lime sodas. Worth ₹960 a la carte.

dishes.name: Chocolate Brownie
dishes.short: Fudgy dark chocolate brownie, warm on request.
dishes.long: Dense, fudgy and deeply chocolatey, with a crackled top. Ask for it warm. The easiest way to end any meal.
